draw: 2026 Big Game drawing (limited-entry, general-season, dedicated hunter, youth elk) and 2026 Antlerless drawing
choice_basis: 1st-choice only. "applicants" = ParticipantCount, the number of applicants who listed this hunt as their 1st choice at that point level; "drawn" = SuccessfulCount, permits drawn by those 1st-choice applicants (max-point round + regular/random round). Permits drawn by applicants who listed the hunt as 2nd-5th choice (general deer, antlerless) are not in the rows; their per-residency all-choices total is in "drawn_all_choices" when it differs. Youth-round draws (general deer, DH, antlerless: youths drawn in the reserved youth round) are in "youth" and excluded from res/nr; youths who failed the youth round re-enter and are counted in res/nr rows. Lifetime license holders (general deer) get permits outside the draw and are in "lifetime", not in rows. q = official quotas from the same API (ResidentQuotaQuantity / NonResidentQuotaQuantity / QuotaQuantity); res/nr null where the API has none.

sources.label: Draw odds data endpoint (Big Game / Antlerless, licenseYear=2026, masterHuntTypeID 5, 6, 8, 9, 17, 18, 32)

notes: Limited-entry and CWMU hunts use bonus points; general-season deer and antlerless hunts use preference points.
